◆ aes_decrypt()

bool mapf::encryption::aes_decrypt ( const uint8_t *  key,
const uint8_t *  iv,
uint8_t *  ciphertext,
int  clen,
uint8_t *  plaintext,
int &  plen 
)

AES128-CBC Decryption.

Perform AES128 CBC (cipher block chaining) decryption on given ciphertext and write the output decrypted data into the plaintext buffer. plaintext and ciphertext can be the same buffer (in place decryption). Padding is handled internally, so the decrypted buffer can be up to 16 bytes larger than the plaintext buffer, and therefore this function will fail if the given plen is not big enough (>= plen + 16). Key and IV should be the same as block size, which is 16 bytes since we are using 128 bit AES (i.e. a 128 bit key). The IV size for most modes is the same as the block size.

Parameters
[in]key16 byte encryption key
[in]iv16 bytes random initialization vector
[in]ciphertextbytestream (data to decrypt)
[in]clenlength of ciphertext buffer
[out]plaintextoutput buffer of encrypted data (can be the same as ciphertext buffer)
[in,out]plenin - length of plaintext buffer (>= clen + 16) out - length of output plaintext
Returns
true on success
false on failure

int &  clen

AES128-CBC Encryption.

Perform AES128 CBC (cipher block chaining) encryption on given plaintext and write the output encrypted data into the ciphertext buffer. plaintext and ciphertext can be the same buffer (in place encryption). Padding is handled internally, so the encrypted buffer can be up to 16 bytes larger than the plaintext buffer, and therefore this function will fail if the given clen is not big enough (>= plen + 15). Key and IV should be the same as block size, which 16 bytes since we are using 128 bit AES (i.e. a 128 bit key). The IV size for most modes is the same as the block size.

Parameters
[in]key16 bytes encryption key
[in]iv16 bytes random initialization vector
[in]plaintextbytestream (data to encrypt)
[in]plenplaintext buffer length
[out]ciphertextoutput buffer of encrypted data (can be the same as plaintext buffer)
[in,out]clenin - length of ciphertext buffer (>= plen + 15) out - length of output ciphertext
Returns
true on success
false failure

◆ wps_calculate_keys()

void mapf::encryption::wps_calculate_keys ( const diffie_hellman &  dh,
const uint8_t *  remote_pubkey,
size_t  remote_pubkey_length,
const uint8_t *  m1_nonce,
const uint8_t *  mac,
const uint8_t *  m2_nonce,
uint8_t *  authkey,
uint8_t *  keywrapkey 
)

Calculate WPS secret authkey and KeyWrapKey based on remote and local public keys generated with diffie-hellman key exchange, WSC M1 and M2 nonces, and M1 MAC address. The authkey used for the Key Wrap Algorithm to generate the KWA, used for the Key Wrap Authenticator attribute of the M2 WSC TLV. The keywrapkey is used for AES encryption/decryption of M2 WSC encrypted settings.

Parameters
[in]dhdiffie helman instance containing the local public key
[in]remote_pubkeyremote public key (from M1 or M2 WSC TLV)
[in]remote_pubkey_lengthremote public key length
[in]m1_nonceWSC M1 TLV enrollee nonce attribute
[in]macWSC M1 TLV mac attribute
[in]m2_nonceWSC M2 TLV registrar nonce attribute
[out]authkeycalculated 256 bit authentication key
[out]keywrapkeycalculated 128 bit keywrapkey
Returns
true on success, false on error
